project.name: vantage.nvim
project.description: A Neovim-first AI review and learning assistant with a local TypeScript backend.

nodes.name: Neovim plugin
nodes.summary: Lua runtime that exposes Vantage commands, UI, annotation rendering, context loading, and backend process communication inside Neovim.

nodes.name: TypeScript backend
nodes.summary: Local Node backend that validates JSON protocol requests and executes model-backed commands through Pi or the development runtime.

nodes.name: Pi Agent Runtime
nodes.summary: Pi SDK integration with prompt contracts, session affinity, credential resolution, tracing, timeout, cancellation, and retry behavior.

nodes.name: Distribution tooling
nodes.summary: pnpm/mise-backed scripts and CI workflow that compile, test, package, and publish the distributable dist branch.

nodes.name: Vantage Agent Session
nodes.summary: Workspace/model/lens-scoped in-memory conversation state used to share context across Vantage commands and reuse Pi session affinity.

nodes.name: Agent Context Artifact
nodes.summary: Workspace-local markdown snapshot that adjacent coding agents maintain and Vantage injects into backend prompts when fresh enough.

nodes.name: Effect robustness boundary
nodes.summary: Typed Effect error and orchestration layer around request handling, model completion, credentials, tracing, cancellation, retry, and timeout behavior.

nodes.name: agent-session.ts
nodes.summary: Maintains in-memory Vantage Agent Sessions scoped by workspace, model target, and lens mode, including bounded turn history and agent context revision tracking.

nodes.name: pi-agent-runtime.test.ts

nodes.name: pi-agent-runtime.ts

nodes.summary: Test coverage and regression checks for pi oauth auth.test.

nodes.name: handlers.ts
nodes.summary: Effect-based request orchestration boundary that reports progress, constructs the configured agent runtime, runs backend commands, and normalizes failures into BackendResponse errors.

nodes.name: stdio-server.ts
nodes.summary: Runs the newline-delimited JSON stdio server, parses/cancels requests, tracks in-flight AbortControllers, emits progress, and delegates work to the backend handler through Effect.

nodes.name: agent-runtime-factory.ts
nodes.summary: Builds the active runtime from user configuration, sharing a process-wide AgentSessionStore across Pi runtime instances.

edges.description: Lua backend client depends on the compiled stdio backend.
Commands delegate model-backed flows to shared model command helpers.
Model command helpers call the backend client.
Annotation requests flow through the backend client.
Lua agent context metadata is rendered into backend prompt contracts.
CI invokes the plugin package build script.
mise pins the pnpm tool used by package scripts.
pnpm workspace configuration supports dependency installation.
Domain glossary documents agent session terminology.

tour.title: Project Overview and Vocabulary
tour.description: Start with the README and domain glossary to understand Vantage as a Neovim-first AI review and learning assistant with a Lua plugin and local TypeScript backend.
tour.languageLesson: The repository uses domain documentation to align UI concepts, backend contracts, and future agent behavior.

tour.title: Neovim Entry Point and Command Surface
tour.description: Inspect the plugin entrypoint and command module to see how user commands such as explain, question, edit, annotate, session status, and hunk review enter the Lua runtime.

tour.title: Editor-to-Backend Request Flow
tour.description: Follow model command helpers and the Lua backend client to understand how selections, annotation scopes, progress events, cancellations, and final responses cross the stdio boundary.

tour.title: Backend Dispatch and Effect Robustness
tour.description: Study the Effect-based handler boundary and command dispatcher to see how validated requests become runtime method calls with typed error normalization.

tour.title: Pi Runtime, Sessions, Credentials, and Prompt Contracts
tour.description: The Pi runtime is the core model integration: it builds prompts, resolves OAuth/API credentials, manages Vantage Agent Sessions, applies timeout/retry/cancellation, and parses model responses.

tour.title: Annotations, Agent Context, and UI Feedback
tour.description: Review the Lua modules responsible for agent context snapshots, inline annotation blocks, floating UI, status messages, and buffer edit application.

tour.title: Testing Strategy
tour.description: Backend node tests and headless Neovim specs cover the protocol, runtime behavior, cancellation, annotations, development runtime, and editor integration.

tour.title: Packaging and Distribution
tour.description: Finish with pnpm/mise tooling and the distribution workflow that compiles, tests, packages, and publishes the dist branch for plugin managers.
